response.justification: Bogdan brings a long, varied hands-on engineering career (roughly 15 years of professional work, spanning web, mobile, embedded, and high-throughput backend systems) and genuine open-source and community leadership. However, the role is a director-level IC focused on AI strategy, cloud platform futures, and advising strategic customers — areas where the resume shows almost no evidence. AI/ML exposure is limited to recent MCP/agent tooling work at re:cinq, there is no cloud platform architecture or strategy leadership (AWS CDK usage aside), no executive-level or customer-advisory experience, and no demonstrated AI products or platforms at scale. The seniority trajectory (Senior/Staff IC) is also several levels below the Principal/Director expectation.
strengths: Deep, broad hands-on engineering across web, embedded, and high-throughput systems (millions of req/s at Sociomantic)
Founder of an open-source geo-data platform plus strong OSS portfolio, conference talks, and workshops — evidence of technical influence and teaching
Early exposure to agentic AI infrastructure (MCP code generators, agent frameworks) at re:cinq
concerns: No recognized AI/ML expertise or shipped AI products/platforms; AI work is recent and tooling-level only
No cloud platform strategy, product-direction, or strategic customer/partner advisory experience
Career level (Senior/Staff IC) is well below the director-level Principal Engineer scope required

key_factors.factor: Lack of AI depth and demonstrated AI products
Long, versatile engineering track record with OSS and community leadership
